'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Christopher Bennett LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Christopher Bennett]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Jupy'''. Handwritten. Line 3 Anakin / PAD… (V) → Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Learner (vision FAR/Ascrusia rejected); line 13 KRAYT DRAGON & ARMED → Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous (V); lines 17–18 NABARRIE LEADS → Padmé Naberrie; line 32 HAN (V); line 33 LANDO w/ VIBRO → Lando With Vibro-Ax; line 40 THREEPIO W/ PARTS SHOW → Threepio With His Parts Showing; shield 1 TRAGEDY OCCURRED → A Tragedy Has Occurred (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Jupy
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
